description: Estimate DIY vs full-service moving costs from distance and home size, with a line-by-line breakdown and range.

faqs.a: Full-service = base fee + per-mile charge + per-bedroom packing/labor. DIY = truck rental + fuel per mile + supplies per bedroom. Each is shown as a ±15% range.
No — these are ballpark planning figures from a simple cost model, not quotes. Get 3 real quotes before booking.
DIY is usually 50–70% cheaper for long moves, but costs you time, driving stress and heavy lifting. Compare the savings against your schedule.

howto: Enter the move distance in miles and number of bedrooms.
Pick DIY or full-service (or compare both).
Read the estimate range and cost breakdown.
title: Moving Cost Estimator
